Looking for a simple way to stay mobile and active, ease joint pain or arthritis, or warm up before your gym workout?
This full-body warm-up routine (my go-to) improves joint mobility, circulation, and movement quality before workouts or daily activities.
Gentle, effective, and suitable for all fitness levels.
A proper warm-up helps your body move more effectively, feel lighter, and stay injury-free. This routine focuses on controlled movements and joint mobility to prepare your entire body for activity.
In this session, you’ll work on:
• neck, shoulder, and spine mobility
